title: Open-model handoff and certification workflow for weights-to-serving
creator: Nina Park
description: Implement an end-to-end handoff and certification workflow that takes a new open-source model weight bundle from community intake through deterministic conversion, automated quality & performance certification, and canonical version pin publishing. Focus: create a reproducible, auditable pipeline that produces a signed manifest + profile ready for Runtime consumption and Console publication.
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible automation run ingests a public weight tarball and outputs a canonical conversion artifact with a hash-signed manifest
Conversion step produces runtime-compatible artifacts for xformers-style and standard kernels with a clear compatibility label
Automated smoke + perf suite runs and publishes a profile with latency percentiles, token/sec curves, and memory at 8, 32, and 1024 token contexts
Quality gate fails if generation regression (embedding/candidate-ranking) exceeds configured thresholds against the baseline prompt set
Published pin (version tag) appears in model catalog with provenance links, license check result, and compatibility matrix
Full run attaches provenance metadata (dataset of prompts used, commit hashes, conversion flags) and stores logs in Artifact Store for 180 days
tasks: Define handoff API spec between Ingest Orchestrator and Conversion workers (format, required fields, error codes)
Add deterministic conversion mode: set seeds, float determinism flags, and verify KVs reproduce across runs
Implement license & provenance validator (automated SPDX check + source URL fuzzing)
Hook up perf harness with representative prompt sets and capture p50/p95/p99 latency, tokens/sec, and memory footprint
Add golden-regression runner: compare outputs on standard prompt set and compute semantic similarity + embedding drift
Create manifest signer that produces an attestation (artifact hash, conversion flags, runtime profile ID) and stores key ID in KMS
Publish pinflow: create mechanism to create a canonical pin record linked to manifests and profile in model catalog
Expose publish events to Console and notify ML-eng Slack channel with links to required artifacts

notes: Trade-offs: full deterministic conversion slows conversion throughput (approx +12% CPU) but enables reproducible profiling and faster debugging. Plan to expose a non-deterministic fast-path for community turnaround builds and reserve deterministic mode for candidate certification runs. Failure modes: if perf harness is flaky due to cloud burstiness, tests will be retried up to 3 times and flagged for manual inspection. We must ensure licensing checks run as early as possible to avoid wasted compute. Rollout: start with opt-in experimental cohort (internal ML teams) then auto-publish after 4 successful certified runs.
